title: Fixed Size Window
definition: A technique used on arrays/strings to perform operations on a specific window size 'K'. Instead of recalculating the entire window every time it moves, we subtract the element leaving the window and add the element entering it.
simpleExplanation: Looking at an array through a rectangular picture frame. When you move the frame one inch to the right, you only look at the sliver of new picture that appeared, instead of staring at the whole frame again.

answers.question: **Basic:** Identify the core logic required to implement Fixed Window.
**Intermediate 1:** Solve a standard problem using Fixed Window in O(N log N) or O(N) time.
**Intermediate 2:** Adapt Fixed Window to handle strings or distinct objects instead of numbers.
**Advanced:** Use Fixed Window to solve a complex sub-array or sub-string problem (e.g. Longest non-repeating).
**Expert/FAANG:** Optimize Fixed Window to achieve strictly O(1) space constraints while maintaining linear time.
